publicId.note: The existing numeric ID is retained as a legacy component, but an upstream source ID is never treated as authority for public identity.

sourceIdentity.note: A source ID may change between upstream releases without changing the CSC public ID.

matching.externalIdPolicy: An external ID is corroborating evidence only when unique in scope and spatially plausible.

migrationEvents.splitRule: A split must list every successor public ID and cannot choose an automatic redirect.
migrationEvents.mergeRule: A merge must list exactly one canonical successor public ID.

releasePolicy.patch: Identity-preserving metadata, alias, display-name, or coordinate corrections.
releasePolicy.minor: Additive entities or fields that do not change existing public identity semantics.
releasePolicy.major: Public schema removals or destructive hierarchy-semantic changes that require consumer migration. Adding an explicit district layer while retaining legacy city identities is non-destructive. Public ID reuse is forbidden even in a major release.
